about_short_description.short_description: SHL, a leader in the home financing sector, provides expert counsel and solutions to help realize the goal of home ownership.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: A Shariah-compliant financing product for individuals to meet personal financial needs without salary transfer requirements.

product.name: Self-Build Financing
product.description: A Shariah-compliant financing product providing liquidity for customers to build property using Murabaha contract terms.

product.name: Ready Units Financing
product.description: A Shariah-compliant financing product for purchasing ready real estate units through Ijarah or Murabaha contracts.

product.name: Commercial Financing
product.description: Financing solutions for businesses to acquire or develop commercial or residential properties with flexible repayment options.

product.name: Mortgage Financing
product.description: A financing product allowing customers to mortgage their property to obtain commercial financing with flexible repayment terms.

product.name: Personal Finance Calculator
product.description: A digital tool to estimate personal financing amounts and monthly installments based on user financial inputs.
